description: SwiftUI view for managing voice wake words settings, including adding, removing, resetting, and synchronizing trigger words.

classes.name: VoiceWakeWordsSettingsView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for configuring voice wake words, with functionalities to add, delete, reset, and synchronize trigger words.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds an empty string to the list of trigger words.

methods.name: removeWords
methods.description: Removes trigger words at specified offsets and resets to defaults if list becomes empty.

methods.name: binding
methods.description: Provides a binding for a specific trigger word index.

methods.name: commitTriggerWords
methods.description: Saves, sanitizes, and synchronizes trigger words with the app model.
